title: envelope
description: The outer shape every answer shares.

ran.description: Where the answer came from, so a reader that gathers answers from many things, apps and versions can tell each answer's source apart (ADR-S08).

name.description: The thing the answer is about (a board, a design, a project). One server serving many things names each answer with its own thing, so a reader that gathers answers from many things (a read over a pattern or a connection, control-room) can tell them apart.

app.description: The product ID of the app that answered; a reader such as servers uses it to tell its own app on a port.

version.description: The version of the app that answered; a reader such as servers uses it to tell its own app on a port.

contract.description: The contract version the answer is in.

data.description: The answer itself; its shape is the kind's schema.

errors.description: Empty when the answer is good.
